Protecting the weak, from Nami's village to Dressrosa's toys and Wano's starving people, structures every arc.
Luffy recruits crewmates one by one and befriends allies on every island, building a Grand Fleet.
Nakama, the bond among the Straw Hats, is the series' central value.
Ace's death, the Going Merry's funeral, and tragic backstories for Chopper, Robin, Brook, and Sanji bring tears in every arc.
Gag faces, Luffy's idiocy, Sanji's nosebleeds, Zoro getting lost, and absurd villains make it a comedy throughout.
Sanji's humiliations, Usopp's cowardice exposed, and comic mishaps recur.
Robin's historical deductions and negotiations with allies occur, but debates are secondary to action.
The Straw Hat crew, pirate alliances, Marines, Emperors' fleets, and the Grand Fleet make group identity everything.
Becoming Pirate King, bounties, Warlord and Emperor titles, and rankings of strength drive the whole world.
Blackbeard covets others' powers and Bellamy mocks dreamers; envy is secondary.
Luffy's rage when friends are hurt, at Arlong, Crocodile, and Akainu, drives his fiercest fights.
Arlong's and Hody's hatred of humans, Doflamingo's cruelty, and Akainu's contempt for pirates fuel villainy.
Boa Hancock's devotion to Luffy and Sanji's crushes appear, but romance is marginal.
Sanji's lechery, Brook's requests, and Nami and Robin's fanservice are running gags.
Hancock's steadfast love, Oden and Toki, and Bell-mere's household show lasting commitment, briefly.
Sanji's constant lust and Brook's panty jokes are comic, not plot.
Sanji's jealousy over Nami and Hancock's possessiveness are played for laughs.
Sexual rivalry is nearly absent.
Absalom's attempt to force a wedding on Nami and Big Mom's forced marriage of Sanji are coercive.
Incest plays no role.
Bell-mere dies protecting Nami and Nojiko, Whitebeard shelters his sons, and Garp and Dadan raise Luffy.
Zeff raises Sanji, Hiriluk nurtures Chopper, Garp and Rayleigh train Luffy, and Oden mentors his retainers.
Luffy, Ace, and Sabo as sworn brothers, Whitebeard's family, Nami and Bell-mere, and Sanji's Vinsmokes make kinship central.
